title: Storms on the Wires, Carbon in the Stack: Where Duke Energy's Climate Risk Actually Sits
detail: Hurricane Helene's bill landed on poles and transformers, not power stations; the ClimRisk engine finds Duke's 51 fossil plants carry modest storm risk but a mean carbon-driven loss of $19bn to $33bn to 2050 if US policy tightens after 2030.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
